name: Mister Versatile
source:
The Lone Wolf Mister Versatile thinks super teams are a pain in the ass, but four super-hotties have decided they want to watch his back anyway.

Mister Versatile is screwed, and not in the good way. Baddies have penetrated his tender headquarters.  Will Mr. V finally let down his guard and get the help he needs?

If so, which superhero will teach him how to play nice with others?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ypressgames/mister-versatile]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
独来独往的Mister Versatile觉得，超级英雄团队就是个烦人的玩意儿。然而，四位火辣的超级英雄，却决定无论如何都要替他守住后背。

Mister Versatile这下可惨了，而且可不是床上那种“惨”。坏人已经侵入了他脆弱的总部。V先生终于会放下戒心，接受自己需要的帮助吗？

如果他愿意，又是哪位超级英雄，会教会他如何与别人好好相处？

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ypressgames/mister-versatile]Kickstarter[/url]]
